text_block_list.name: Cameraman
text_block_list.text:
"Look right over here, eyes slightly up... 
Nice, that's wonderful!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Curren Bouquetd'or, who brilliantly swept 
the Tenno Sho (Autumn), Japan Cup, and 
Arima Kinen all in the same year.

To honor her achievements, it was decided 
that a magazine would run a special 
feature on her.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
Once again, could you share your feelings 
on achieving the Senior Autumn Triple 
Crown right now?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
My heart is full. To think... the day 
would come when I'd receive such an honor.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"It's all thanks to you, Trainer, for 
constantly and wholeheartedly supporting 
me. Please let me thank you once again."

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. When you think of Bouquet, you 
think of Trainer <username>, after all.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Yes. —Even before entering into our 
contract, I was well aware of how caring 
you are toward Umamusume, and how 
exceptionally capable you are.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
“Yet, over these past three years, I came 
to feel firsthand that at his core, there 
was always kindness for the Umamusume he 
was responsible for—”

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"However, throughout these three years, 
having felt firsthand that her kindness 
toward her trainee Umamusume is always at 
the core of everything she does—"

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"I want you to run the way you want to 
run."—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"‘I want you to run the way you want to 
run’—"

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
It is no exaggeration to say that your 
words were what bound this brilliant 
bouquet of Senior bloomers together.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Praise flowing without hesitation. 
Honestly, it's a little embarrassing.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. What passionate thoughts... Sorry to 
put you on the spot, Trainer, but hearing 
that right next to them, what do you 
think?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Fufuâ There are still mountains of 
stories I would love to share with you 
here.
choice_data_list: T-There's still a whole mountain left...?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Day after day, they assemble my menu with 
the utmost care and attention.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Did you perhaps test out form improvement 
ideas on your own body beforehand—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Her bentos are truly wonderful as well. 
She always knows best what nutrients I 
need at any given moment—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"Above all, the seasoning is exceptionally 
well done. There is no restaurant that 
could ever surpass the boxed lunches he 
makes."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"Above all, the seasoning is exceptionally 
well done. There is no restaurant that 
could ever surpass the boxed lunches she 
makes."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Besides—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Ah―― I'm sorry. I ended up talking for too 
long, didn't I?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Um—I just wanted as many people as 
possible to get to know more about you—

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu! I could feel Bouquet-san's 
gratitude very clearly.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
I'll make sure to write a thorough article 
about this. Thank you so much for the 
valuable story.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Haaah—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry about today. My heart just felt 
so light and excited.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: I ended up rambling a bit too much.
choice_data_list: Your feelings truly made me so happy.
The thought really meant a lot to me.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
—Thank you very much. Hearing you say that 
takes a load off my mind.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
No—I thought my longing for the Triple 
Tiara back then had faded away, but...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"I wonder if it came full circle—changing 
its shape, and returning as a different 
bouquet of flowers."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
The yearning, the resignation, the 
determination from that day. I wonder if 
none of those days were in vain after all—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: When I think about that—my heart trembles.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: So right now, I'm extremely—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu, that's how I feel.
